source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the ABO system, block for block; the book's problems are self-checks, one with a drawn Punnett square (PDF 92-94).

blocks.text: ABO system Landsteiner ne 1901 mein daryaft kiya. Us ne red blood cells (RBCs) par do antigens paye: antigen-A aur antigen-B. Us ne dekha ke kuch logon ke RBCs par antigen-A hai aur kuch par antigen-B, aur bohat se logon mein in mein se koi bhi nahi. Baad mein Landsteiner ke shagirdon ne dekha ke kuch logon ke RBCs par A aur B dono antigens hain. Is liye blood groups ke naam yun rakhe gaye:

items: Antigen-A wale log: blood group A
Antigen-B wale log: blood group B
Antigen-A aur antigen-B dono wale log: blood group AB
Na antigen-A na antigen-B wale log: blood group O

blocks.text: Har shakhs ke blood plasma mein us antigen ke khilaf antibodies hoti hain jo us ke apne RBCs par nahi:
Ise Landsteiner ka antigen–antibody relationship ka qaida kehte hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Kuch log A aur B antigens jism ke mayi (body fluids) jaise thook (saliva), aansu aur peshab mein bhi chhorte hain. Un ke chromosome 19 par aik dominant secretor gene 'Se' hota hai.

ABO system ko gene I control karta hai ('I' ka matlab iso-haem-agglutinogen). Yeh gene chromosome 9 par hai aur is ke multiple alleles hain: Iᴬ, Iᴮ aur i. Iᴬ aur Iᴮ aapas mein co-dominant hain, jab ke i dono ke muqable mein recessive hai. Iᴬ antigen-A banata hai, Iᴮ antigen-B banata hai, aur i koi antigen nahi banata. Is liye:

items: IᴬIᴬ aur Iᴬi antigen-A banate hain: blood group A. Plasma mein anti-B antibodies.
IᴮIᴮ aur Iᴮi antigen-B banate hain: blood group B. Plasma mein anti-A antibodies.
IᴬIᴮ dono antigens (A aur B) banata hai: blood group AB. Plasma mein na anti-A na anti-B.
ii koi antigen nahi banata: blood group O. Plasma mein anti-A aur anti-B dono.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke ABO system mein anti-A aur anti-B antibodies banne ke liye antigens ka saamna zaroori nahi, aur yeh janeen (embryo) ki zindagi se ban'ne lagti hain aur umr bhar rehti hain. Aam medical hawalon ke mutabiq yeh antibodies paidaish ke baad pehle chand maheenon mein zahir hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Aik mard ka blood group A aur us ki biwi ka B hai. Un ke chaar bachche hain aur har aik ka blood group alag hai. Cross ka Punnett square bana kar samjhayein ke yeh kaise mumkin hai.
blocks.explanation: Dono walidain heterozygous hon to: baap Iᴬi, maa Iᴮi. Baap Iᴬ ya i deta hai, maa Iᴮ ya i. Punnett square mein IᴬIᴮ (AB), Iᴬi (A), Iᴮi (B) aur ii (O) aate hain, har aik 1/4 probability se. Is liye chaar bachchon ke chaar mukhtalif blood groups ho sakte hain.

answer_figure.alt: Punnett square: baap group A (Iᴬi) ke gametes Iᴬ aur i baen taraf, maa group B (Iᴮi) ke gametes Iᴮ aur i oopar. Khane: IᴬIᴮ group AB, Iᴬi group A, Iᴮi group B, ii group O. Neeche: AB : A : B : O = 1 : 1 : 1 : 1.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): group A (Iᴬi) × group B (Iᴮi) ka Punnett square
answer_figure.long_description: Oopar 'Father: group A (Iᴬi) × Mother: group B (Iᴮi)'. Grid ke oopar maa ke gametes Iᴮ aur i, baen taraf baap ke gametes Iᴬ aur i. Pehli qatar: IᴬIᴮ (Group AB), Iᴬi (Group A). Doosri qatar: Iᴮi (Group B), ii (Group O). Har khana alag rang ka hai. Neeche likha hai: chaar bachche, chaar blood groups, AB : A : B : O = 1 : 1 : 1 : 1.

blocks.prompt: Blood group B wali aurat ka bachcha blood group O hai. Maa aur bachche ke genotypes kya hain? Baap ke kaun se genotypes nahi ho sakte?
blocks.explanation: Bachcha ii hai, is liye maa Iᴮi hai (us ne i diya). Baap ne bhi i diya hoga, is liye baap IᴬIᴬ, IᴮIᴮ ya IᴬIᴮ nahi ho sakta (in mein i nahi).

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Mendel ke matar mein har khasiyat aik aise gene se control hoti thi jis ke do alleles the, aur aik allele doosre par poori tarah dominant tha. Lekin incomplete dominance aur co-dominance dominance ke is qaide ko nahi maante. Isi tarah multiple allelic system mein gene ke do se zyada alleles hote hain, jin mein se koi do mil kar phenotype banate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar column wala table. Genotypes IAIA ya IAi, IBIB ya IBi, IAIB aur ii. Red blood cells par antigens: aik cell par gol antigen-A, doosre par chaukor antigen-B, teesre par dono, chauthe par koi antigen nahi. Plasma mein antibodies (Y shaklein): anti-B; anti-A; na anti-A na anti-B; anti-A aur anti-B. Phenotypes (blood groups): A, B, AB, O.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.4: ABO nizam ke genotypes aur phenotypes (kitab ki Figure 18.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har column aik blood group hai. Oopar genotype, beech mein RBC par antigens (A gol nishan, B chaukor), neeche plasma ki antibodies (Y shaklein). Qaida yaad rakhein: jo antigen RBC par nahi, us ki antibody plasma mein hoti hai. AB mein koi antibody nahi, O mein dono.
ABO system mein transfusion ka usool

Jab aise do blood groups ke darmiyan khoon diya jaye jo aapas mein na milte hon (incompatible), to lene wale (recipient) ki antibodies dene wale (donor) ke RBCs ke antigens par hamla karti hain. Is se RBCs aapas mein chipak kar guchhe ban jate hain (agglutination). Aisa tab hota hai:

items: Jab blood group A wale ko blood group B diya jaye, ya B wale ko A.
Jab donor AB ho aur recipient A, B ya O ho.
O blood group (donor): is par na antigen-A hai na antigen-B, is liye ise A, B, AB ya O sab ko diya ja sakta hai. Is liye O group wale ABO system ke universal donors kehlate hain.
AB blood group (recipient): is mein na anti-A hai na anti-B antibodies, is liye yeh har qisam ka khoon le sakta hai. Is liye AB group wale ABO system ke universal recipients kehlate hain.

blocks.title: Recessive allele 'i' aabadi mein zyada kyun hai?
blocks.text:
• O (ii) × O (ii) cross mein sab bachche blood group O (ii) hote hain.
• Heterozygous Iᴬi × Iᴬi cross mein 25% bachche blood group O (ii) hote hain.
• Heterozygous Iᴮi × Iᴮi cross mein 25% bachche blood group O (ii) hote hain.
• Heterozygous Iᴬi × Iᴮi cross mein bhi 25% bachche blood group O (ii) hote hain.
Kitab ke mutabiq isi liye blood group allele 'i' aabadi mein zyada paya jata hai.

items: ABO: gene I chromosome 9 par; alleles Iᴬ, Iᴮ (co-dominant) aur i (recessive).
Plasma mein us antigen ki antibody hoti hai jo RBC par nahi (Landsteiner ka qaida).
Incompatible khoon se agglutination; O universal donor, AB universal recipient (ABO system mein).
